# Moru Core v26.44.1

This release extends the optional Rust runtime to repeated file/Git inspection,
quiet prompt mailboxes and quiet/settled Claude/Codex Stop callbacks. It also
includes the registered-evidence lookup optimization, developer-cache
compatibility, unfinished-work continuity and archive operand safety changes
since v26.44.0.

## Download and install

Use a `moru-native-*.tar.gz` asset matching your OS/CPU and Core source at
`v26.44.1`. Preserve existing local changes when selecting the release. For a
new checkout only:

```sh
git clone --branch v26.44.1 https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core.git ~/.moru/core
cd ~/.moru/core
python3 scripts/native-runtime-bundle.py install --bundle /path/to/moru-native-macos-arm64.tar.gz
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --dry-run
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --check
```

Reuse an existing checkout when present. Python 3.9+ and Git remain required;
receivers do not need Rust or Cargo. Release assets are durable public downloads
and have no seven-day Actions retention timer.

## Verification and limits

The existing CI matrix builds macOS ARM64/x86_64 and Linux ARM64/x86_64 with
pinned Rust and locked crates. Release promotion requires every platform's
behavior tests and 19 transported-consumer callback checks to pass. `BUILD.json`
records the exact original source/run and archive hashes; `SHA256SUMS` covers
the four archives. The release tag identifies that build source.

The consumer smoke copies the complete guarded runtime source and directory
shape into a fresh root. Lookup/statusline/pretool checks run with empty PATH;
quiet mailbox/Stop checks retain only Git after isolated fixture preparation.
It does not use live sessions or messages.

Selected callback paths have substantial local wall/CPU/RSS improvements.
These are Mac fixture measurements, not whole-agent, cross-host or token-saving
claims. Python compatibility paths retain authority and effects; measured
active Stop replay adds about 6.8 ms in the retained local experiment.

No state schema migration or credential change is required. Existing renderer
chains and Spill connections are preserved. Set `MORU_LAUNCHER_BACKEND=python`
and `MORU_CHECKOUT_IDENTITY_BACKEND=python` for explicit native rollback.
macOS targets 13+; Linux is built/tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Older glibc and Windows
are not established compatible.

Full source comparison: https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core/compare/v26.44.0...v26.44.1
